description: Merge several renders into one PDF, in the order given, for example one certificate or invoice per recipient. Image renders become PDF pages. Use this after creating the individual renders. Each merge counts toward the account's render usage. Returns the URL of the merged PDF. With host set to false the PDF itself is returned inline instead, which only works for PDFs up to 100 KB.

host.description: true (default): return a URL to the merged PDF. false: return the PDF inline as an embedded file, for PDFs up to 100 KB.

render_ids.description: Render IDs to merge, in page order

name: merge_renders
